title: ActiMotus Validation — Reproducibility Package
description:
Validation of the ActiMotus human activity recognition algorithm against video ground truth, on five public accelerometry datasets covering children, adults and older adults.

Three scripts regenerate every table and confusion matrix in the study. Nothing is precomputed: the data is fetched from HuggingFace at pinned revisions and the algorithm is installed from PyPI, so the package supplies only the pipeline between them. Each stage records the ActiMotus version and dataset revisions it used and refuses a cache built from different inputs.

Datasets (thigh, most with an additional lower-back sensor): NTNU Adults (31), NTNU Children (46 typically developing), NTNU Older Adults (18, aged 70–95), NTNU Walking Speeds (24), and Lendt Adults (35). Each is pinned to an exact HuggingFace commit. No data is redistributed here.

Overall agreement with video ground truth, ActiMotus 2.3.3 with its built-in thresholds: Lendt laboratory 0.995, Lendt free-living 0.889, NTNU Adults 0.824 thigh-only and 0.880 with the back sensor, NTNU Children 0.831 / 0.848, NTNU Older Adults 0.791 / 0.824, NTNU Walking Speeds 0.795. Per-activity precision, recall and F1 with 90% confidence intervals are written to the result tables.

Full documentation, including sensor-orientation handling and known limitations, is in the repository README.
